verdict.rationale: Aider builds an automatic repo map (concise map of classes/functions with call signatures) and supports /ask and /map to explore and explain code without manually adding files, and community reports confirm it can explain unfamiliar codebases faster than manual grep/search. However, full context still typically requires adding files for edits, and the repo map is a heuristic summary rather than a guaranteed full explanation of an entire large codebase. missing for 10: independent benchmarks on very large/unfamiliar codebases, evidence of automatic full-codebase file selection without any /add or /ask prompting, and confirmation the repo map scales to huge repos.
